note: Six change requests on public repositories, each pinned to one commit. Written 2026-11-09 before any reference list or trial existed.

tasks.request: Add soft delete for users: deleting a user hides the account but keeps their items, and an admin can restore it within 30 days.
Send every user a weekly email digest of the new posts written by the people they follow.
Let a user sign in with Google or with their password on the same account, linking the two by email address.
Make ky retry POST and PATCH requests by default when the network fails, so that flaky mobile connections stop failing.
Deploy new versions with zero downtime: run the database migrations automatically on every deploy and keep the site up while the new container starts.
Allow an article to have several co-authors, while keeping existing article URLs and API responses working for current clients.
